messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pomaga w szkolnej bibliotece w Kętrzynie; zagląda tu w porze obiadowej.
- zainteresowania: okładki książek, domowe grzanki, zbieranie guzików
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek przy ulicy Sikorskiego w Kętrzynie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Segreguje domowe książki i oddaje przeczytane egzemplarze do wymiany.
- sposób pisania: zdania: medium; interpunkcja: częste wielokropki; wielkie litery: mostly standard, lowercase starts; literówki: rare; skróty: none; emoji: rare
- tik językowy: dopisuje „ot, drobiazg”

For each of the 16 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (morning commute, Sunday)
2. jedzenie i gotowanie - grill, ognisko (morning commute, Tuesday)
3. praca i grafik - nadgodziny / wcześniejsze wyjście (morning commute, Wednesday)
4. sport - basen, zajęcia (evening, Thursday)
5. gry i seriale - maraton serialu, zarwana noc (late night, Friday)
6. komunikacja i dojazdy - pociąg regionalny, przesiadka (early morning, Tuesday)
7. dzieci i rodzina - obiad u rodziców / teściów (evening, Thursday)
8. zakupy i ceny - nowe buty / kurtka (late morning, Thursday)
9. remont i dom - zmiana dostawcy internetu (morning commute, Wednesday)
10. dzieci i rodzina - wakacje, planowanie (late night, Tuesday)
11. gry i seriale - maraton serialu, zarwana noc (late night, Friday)
12. praca i grafik - zmęczenie po zmianie (early morning, Tuesday)
13. zwierzęta - kot i jego humory (evening, Monday)
14. remont i dom - sprzątanie, porządki sezonowe (lunch break, Thursday)
15. drobne narzekanie na usługi - infolinia, oczekiwanie (afternoon, Sunday)
16. technologia i sprzęt - nowy laptop / słuchawki (late night, Friday)

Return a JSON array of 16 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
